_comment: v0.16 P2 (#307). Voice: character-profiles.md 'Den-Shop Keeper'. NEW graph on a NEW entity, so the loop and sign-off surfaces never ride a pinned hub.

hub.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
hub.text: Come in, mind the small ones. If you're buying, the shelf is the shelf. If you're official, the counter's there, and it has been a long month already. There's bread in the oven I need to get back to.

text_variants.text: The tin came up. Four cycles late and every stamp on it correct. Sit down, {addr}. You are eating something.

options.text: I'm here about a crate of tin.

month.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
month.text: A crate of tin, four cycles late, and every stamp on it correct. The permit office cannot release it. Their own supplies have not come in, and nobody up there will put a day to it. I have hatchlings upstairs chewing yesterday's bread and a shelf with a tin-shaped hole in it.

options.text: That can't be how it works.

month_two.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
month_two.text: It is exactly how it works and every single person in that chain is doing their job correctly. Nobody up here is lazy, {addr}. The clerk at the release window checks every stamp twice, both sides, and the dock behind her fills up while she does it.

options.text: Somebody has to be able to sign.

consignee.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
consignee.text: I am the consignee. I have been offered promises and one shout down from the landing. The procedure needs a notice with a stamp on it, one I am allowed to act on. Hand me that and the crate moves the same hour.

options._comment: TALK route terminal rung. Requires the countersigned notice, i.e. offices 1 and 2 walked in order.
HELP route terminal rung. Three legs = the two carry props plus this shop's own receiving dock.
options.text: [Tell her the crate is already on her dock.]
I'll come back with something you can act on.

released.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
released.text: Countersigned. A stamp I can act on, four cycles late. I will send for the crate before the shop closes. I am going to frame this notice.

carried.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
carried.text: You carried it. Two tiers and three legs and no stamp on any of it. That is not how it is done and I am not going to say another word about it. Take the small jar. No, take it.
